en.name: Cheddar
en.summary: Cheddar is a hard, pressed cow's-milk cheese whose low moisture and salt make it one of the longest-keeping things in the fridge. Unopened it keeps about 6 months from purchase, once opened 3–4 weeks, and frozen about 6 months — though freezing costs it its texture.
en.pantry: Cheddar is not a room-temperature food in the sense of storage, even though it is far more robust than a soft cheese. Leave it out and the fat sweats to the surface, it dries and cracks at the edges, and the two-hour rule applies as it does to any dairy product (one hour above 32 °C / 90 °F). Bring it to room temperature for half an hour before serving — that is for flavour — and return the rest to the fridge straight after.
en.fridge: Keep cheddar at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in the main body of the fridge, not the door. Unopened in its vacuum pack it holds about 6 months from purchase; once opened, 3–4 weeks. Wrap cut cheese in waxed or greaseproof paper and then loosely in foil or a box: it needs to breathe a little, and cling film pressed directly against the cut face traps moisture and grows mould faster. Re-wrap in fresh paper each time rather than reusing a damp sheet.
en.freezer: Cheddar freezes for about 6 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F), but it comes back crumbly because the ice crystals break the curd structure. That is fine for grating over pasta, melting into a sauce or topping a gratin, and poor for a cheeseboard. Grate it before freezing and pack it in a sealed bag with a spoonful of cornflour tossed through to stop clumping; freeze blocks in pieces of 250 g or less so they freeze quickly.
en.thawing: Thaw cheddar in the fridge overnight, still wrapped, and use it within about a week. Grated frozen cheddar goes straight onto a dish from the freezer without thawing. Do not thaw cheese at room temperature or in the microwave.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould in blue, green, black or pink on a cut face
A sharp ammonia smell, quite different from cheddar's usual tang
Slimy or sticky surface rather than dry and firm
Unusual darkening, or a bitter, soapy taste
tips: Buy a block rather than pre-grated; grated cheese dries out and moulds far faster.
Wrap in waxed paper, then loosely in foil — not tightly in cling film.
Label the wrapper with the date you opened it; the 3–4 week clock starts then.
Grate the last of a block and freeze it rather than letting the end dry out.

faq.q: How long does cheddar last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 6 months from purchase while the vacuum pack is unopened, and 3–4 weeks once you have opened it, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
Yes, for about 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F). It thaws crumbly, so freeze it grated and use it for cooking rather than for eating as it is.

faq.q: Can you cut mould off cheddar?
faq.a: Yes. For hard cheese, cut at least 2.5 cm (1 inch) around and below the mould spot, keep the knife out of the mould itself, and re-wrap the rest in fresh paper. This applies to hard cheese only, never to soft cheese.

faq.q: Why has my cheddar gone greasy on the surface?
faq.a: The butterfat has separated out, usually because the cheese was left out or the fridge is running warm. It is a quality fault, not a safety one; blot it and keep the cheese colder.

zh.name: 切達起司
zh.summary: 切達是壓製的硬質牛奶起司，水分低、鹽度高，是冰箱裡最耐放的食材之一。未開封從購買日起約可放 6 個月，開封後 3～4 週，冷凍約 6 個月——但冷凍會犧牲口感。
zh.pantry: 切達雖然比軟質起司強韌得多，但就保存而言仍然不是能放室溫的食材。放在外面，油脂會滲到表面、邊緣乾裂，而且兩小時原則對所有乳製品都適用（氣溫超過 32°C 時只有一小時）。上桌前提早半小時回溫是為了風味，吃完請立刻把剩下的收回冰箱。
zh.fridge: 冷藏請維持 4°C 以下，放在冰箱內部而不是門邊。真空包裝未開封的話，從購買日起約可放 6 個月；開封後則是 3～4 週。切開的起司請先用蠟紙或烘焙紙包起來，外面再鬆鬆包一層鋁箔或放進盒子：起司需要一點透氣，保鮮膜直接貼在切面上會鎖住水氣，反而更快發霉。每次都換一張乾淨的紙，不要重複用已經潮濕的那張。
zh.freezer: 切達在 −18°C 冷凍，從購買日起約可放 6 個月，但解凍後會變得鬆散易碎，因為冰晶破壞了凝乳結構。這用來刨在義大利麵上、融進醬汁裡或鋪在焗烤上完全沒問題，但拿來做起司拼盤就不行了。建議先刨絲再冷凍，裝袋時拌一小匙玉米粉可以防止結塊；整塊冷凍請切成 250 公克以下，才凍得快。
zh.thawing: 解凍請連著包裝放冷藏室退冰一晚，並在一週內用完。刨絲的冷凍切達可以不解凍直接撒在料理上。不要在室溫解凍，也不要用微波。
spoilage: 切面長出藍色、綠色、黑色或粉紅色的毛狀黴
有刺鼻的阿摩尼亞味，和切達原本的酸香明顯不同
表面變得黏滑，而不是乾爽結實
顏色異常變深，或吃起來有苦味、肥皂味
tips: 買整塊而不是已刨絲的；刨絲起司乾得快、也更快發霉。
先用蠟紙包，外層再鬆鬆包鋁箔，不要用保鮮膜緊貼。
在包裝上寫下開封日期，3～4 週是從那天開始算。
剩下最後一小塊時直接刨絲冷凍，別放到乾硬。

faq.q: 切達起司放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏，真空未開封從購買日起約 6 個月，開封後 3～4 週。
可以，放 −18°C 約 6 個月。解凍後質地變碎，建議刨絲後冷凍並用於烹調，不要直接單吃。

faq.q: 切達發霉可以把霉切掉嗎？
faq.a: 可以。硬質起司請在霉點周圍和底下各切除至少 2.5 公分，刀子不要碰到霉，再用乾淨的紙重新包好。這個做法只適用硬質起司，軟質起司絕對不行。

faq.q: 切達表面出油是壞掉了嗎？
faq.a: 那是乳脂分離，通常是放在室溫太久或冰箱溫度偏高造成的。屬於品質問題而非安全問題，擦掉後把冰箱調冷一點即可。
